shared_elements: upright figure holding an elongated object (staff/rod-like)
long straight linear element crossing the field
justification: Both depict upright human(oid) figures associated with long straight rod-like elements — in A stick figures holding/flanking long lances or lines, in B a standing figure grasping slender attributes — but that correspondence is about as generic as figural art gets. The differences dominate: A is a scatter of crude schematic stick-limbed figures with no attributes beyond the lines, while B is a single large, carefully proportioned figure with a great feathered wing, patterned garment and headdress standing beside a columnar stylised plant with rosette-like blossoms, none of which has any counterpart in A.
